aboutParagraphs: I'm the Founder & CEO of Digital Nexus, a results-driven Software Engineer, Full-Stack Web Developer, and Digital Marketer based in Sainthamaruthu, Sri Lanka. I specialize in creating powerful, intuitive, and user-focused digital solutions for web and mobile platforms.

My job is to craft scalable web systems and applications that are not only functional and secure but also visually appealing and responsive. I combine modern technologies like React.js and Laravel with smart digital marketing strategies to boost brand presence. From development to design to promotion, I ensure every project I handle delivers real value and standout user experiences.

testimonials.name: Ihsan - Ottamavadi
testimonials.text: Working with Mujahith was a game-changer for our business. He developed a fast, responsive website and handled everything from design to deployment. His attention to detail and technical expertise are unmatched.

testimonials.name: Market Sniper Trader
testimonials.text: Mujahith’s digital marketing campaigns helped us grow our social media reach by over 300% in just a few weeks. He knows how to target the right audience and deliver real results.

testimonials.name: MYMUN Executive - Addalaichenai
testimonials.text: We hired Mujahith to create a POS system for our store, and he delivered exactly what we needed. It's simple, efficient, and has improved our daily operations significantly.

testimonials.name: MACN. Shafana (HOD - FMC) - SEUSL
testimonials.text: Mujahith fixed our entire lab setup at the university—hardware, software, and networking. He’s a reliable IT support specialist who solves problems quickly and professionally.

education.title: Higher National Diploma in Information Technology
education.institution: Sri Lanka Institute of Advanced Technological Education (SLIATE), Sammanthurai. - Sri Lanka

experience.title: Founder & CEO
experience.description: Founded and lead Digital Nexus, a digital services company offering web development, social media marketing, IT support, and software solutions. Delivered full-stack web platforms with secure payment gateways, responsive UI/UX, and custom automation tools. Directed a cross-functional team to complete high-impact projects, ensuring client satisfaction through innovative, scalable, and data-driven solutions. Managed branding, business strategy, and digital advertising to grow a strong local and online presence.

experience.title: Cashier, Digital Marketer & Social Media Manager
experience.description: Developed and implemented a custom POS system using HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript to improve billing and sales operations. Designed a user-friendly interface with real-time calculations, receipt generation, and inventory tracking. Managed daily cash handling, financial reporting, and customer service. Led social media marketing across Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok, producing high-quality graphics, promotional videos, and paid ad campaigns. Analyzed insights, optimized strategies, and supported merchandising efforts to drive engagement and sales.

experience.title: Web Application Developer
experience.company: South Eastern University of Sri Lanka (SEUSL)
experience.description: Developed a Lab Management System using Laravel and React.js with responsive design and secure RESTful APIs. Integrated AJAX for faster load times and optimized MySQL queries for performance. Followed Agile (Scrum), participated in code reviews, and collaborated with cross-functional teams. Performed hardware diagnostics, CMOS battery replacements, OS/software installations, and network troubleshooting for 90 computers.

experience.title: Volunteer - 13th Annual International Research Conference
experience.company: South Eastern University of Sri Lanka (SEUSL)
experience.description: Provided technical support for conference operations, including audiovisual setup and troubleshooting. Assisted with website updates, digital documentation, and cybersecurity. Supported data management and improved digital engagement for attendees.

experience.title: Managing Assistant
experience.description: Oversaw daily petrol station operations, inventory, staff scheduling, and financial reporting. Handled customer service, enforced safety protocols, coordinated with suppliers, and maintained accurate sales records. Worked with maintenance teams to ensure fuel dispenser and facility functionality.

experience.title: Government Welfare Program Enumerator
experience.company: Ministry of Finance - Aswasuma Welfare Program
experience.description: Collected and digitized beneficiary data across 17 GN divisions in Sainthamaruthu. Ensured accurate data entry, collaborated with local officials, and maintained confidentiality. Completed fieldwork ahead of schedule, supporting timely program rollout.

experience.title: Volunteer Member - Youth Combat Force (YCF)
experience.company: National Ethnic Unity Foundation, Ampara District, Sri Lanka
experience.description: Contributed to the Plastic Waste Management Project (2023-25), supporting environmental sustainability through waste collection, segregation, and awareness campaigns. Collaborated with local communities and partner organizations to implement eco-friendly practices and reduce plastic pollution. Organized workshops and public outreach campaigns to promote recycling and responsible plastic use. Maintained progress reports and provided regular updates to stakeholders. Received recognition from the Canada Fund for Local Initiatives for impactful contributions to environmental sustainability.

experience.title: Member - #Politicslk Youth Collective
experience.description: Appointed to the #Politicslk Youth Collective to enhance civic engagement and policy awareness among youth in Sri Lanka. Led project planning, reporting, and execution of educational programs focused on citizen empowerment and democratic literacy. Collaborated with changemakers and policymakers to implement impactful community initiatives and youth-led advocacy campaigns. Participated in national discussions, workshops, and outreach events to drive social change and governance awareness.

experience.title: Volunteer
experience.description: Engaged in digital literacy and cybersecurity awareness programs for youth and communities. Supported the organization of workshops on online safety, cyber ethics, and responsible digital behavior. Contributed to content creation, including articles, infographics, and social media posts. Collaborated with educators and tech experts to develop interactive educational materials. Provided technical support for webinars and digital events, while researching trends in digital safety and misinformation to improve educational outreach.
